text:
maria (sales): FYI CedarBank POC seeing intermittent long time-to-first-token (TTFT) on short customer queries — reported 800ms-2s spikes. Can eng swarm?
zack (eng-runtime): On it. Any repro steps / sample payloads from Cedar?
maria (sales): They sent a small prompt set — most requests are 80-120 tokens output, really bursty. Attached logs showed many requests waiting in batch window. Also asked about cost if we recommend reserved capacity vs on-demand.
elaine (solutions): Quick question — are these requests identical or high-prefix overlap? KV cache effectiveness matters a lot for first-token latency.
maria (sales): Mostly similar prompts (same system + slightly different user text). They expect low latency for chat UX.
nadir (eng-sre): I pulled infra traces — saw frequent cache-miss spikes around 12:18–12:25 UTC, and batching spikes around 100–160ms batch windows. Pileup pattern: lots of concurrent tiny requests causing batching hold time -> TTFT bump.
zack (eng-runtime): Can we try disabling micro-batching for this pool and force immediate dispatch? Suggest set batch_window_ms to 5 (was 50) and max_batch_size to 8 for the POC. Also recommend enabling KV prefetch for top prefixes.
elaine (solutions): For the customer-facing change: tell them to try a short prefill (prefill_tokens: 2) while we test. That reduces first-token generation overhead for many models.
maria (sales): cc @arnold (acct exec) — Cedar asked about per-token pricing if we move to Dedicated.
arnold (acct exec): We can offer a 20% bandwidth discount on a 12-month reserved capacity at their expected commit. Also add 10k burst credits for the POC to avoid 429s during demos.
zack (eng-runtime): Quick debug command for logs if Cedar can run it on their side:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-committed-v1","input":"<sample>","trace":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer | jq .trace
```
That trace shows batching wait time + kv_cache hits/misses.
nadir (eng-sre): From infra: occasional disk-backed KV miss when pod restarted -> cold-shard. We need a pod warmup script for their dedicated pool to prepopulate KV on deploy. Adding that now to the runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy started: inference-pool-cedar-v2 rollout @ 1769456823
zack (eng-runtime): After roll, watch first-byte latency metric: /console/models/cedar-v2/latency?range=30m — check 95p and p99. If still high, temporary workaround: pin to smaller model variant with lower memory working set (quantized) for POC.
elaine (solutions): Security question from Cedar: Where are logs stored and how long? We should send SOC2/KMS bits + their questionnaire. I'll upload standard security packet to the shared drive and ping them.
maria (sales): sending recommended changes + pricing offer to Cedar now. Will ask them to run the curl trace and share results. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
zack (eng-runtime): If they share traces, I can correlate requestId -> pod logs and spot exact batch/window causing delay.
arnold (acct exec): Also noted: if they convert to Dedicated after POC, we can pre-allocate a warm standby pool to eliminate cold-shard misses (adds small fixed monthly fee).
maria (sales): Cedar replied with one sample trace (pasted below) — can someone grep for "batch_wait_ms" and "kv_miss"?
maria (sales): ```{"requestId":"r-0a12","batch_wait_ms":128,"kv_hits":2,"kv_misses":5,"model_time_ms":30}```
zack (eng-runtime): That's the pattern. batch_wait_ms ~128 + kv_misses => first-token ~160ms extra. With their concurrency it stacks. Next steps: temporary config change (batch_window_ms=5, max_batch_size=8), prefill_tokens=2, and enable warm-standby for Dedicated if they commit. I'll follow up after deploy finishes.
elaine (solutions): I'll send the security packet + suggested prod config snippets to Cedar.
maria (sales): Cedar on call at 15:00 UTC, I'll update them after the deploy. Thanks everyone.
